title: HELIX Bridge: Salesforce → StudentProgram
architecture_notes: In most institutions the SIS is the system of record for program of study. Map Salesforce program records only when Salesforce is the source (advising-only programs, continuing education, or Agentforce Education used for academic operations); otherwise use them for reconciliation.

source_objects.description: Agentforce Education: a learner's plan in a learning program.
EDA affiliation, often parent of the program enrollment.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + LearnerProgram.Id or hed__Program_Enrollment__c.Id.
Map to HELIX program status values.
Resolve to HELIX AcademicPeriod; derive from date when only a date exists.
Boolean; default true when only one active program.
Resolve to HELIX Employee where the advisor is staff.

extraction_methods.description: Default. SOQL by SystemModstamp high-water mark; queryAll to include deleted rows. Included with API-enabled editions.
Near real-time change events for objects that need freshness. A limited number of objects is included; more needs an add-on. Check your contract.

validate: Object and field names follow Salesforce's published Agentforce Education (formerly Education Cloud), EDA, NPSP, and standard object models, but orgs add custom fields and record types. VALIDATE every field against your org's describe output before building extracts; custom fields end in __c.
